What you need to do by hand
- Block capitals: the form asks for BLOCK CAPITALS. Your details go back in exactly as they are saved, so if your surname, first names or place of birth don't come out in capitals, copy them over in capitals.
- Date of birth (B03): this comes back the way it's printed in your passport. UK forms usually use DD/MM/YYYY, so if your passport prints it differently (for example "15 JAN 1990"), rewrite it as day/month/year.
- First names (B04): your first name and then your middle name, with a space between them.
- Town and country of birth (B08): check that both the town and the country show. If only the town is there, add the country after it.
- Leeds address and postcode (B09, B10, B15): mdoc doesn't have your Leeds address saved, so write it in yourself. Don't use your saved home address here, because that's your old one, not your Leeds one.
- Telephone (B11): this is the number you have saved. If you now have a UK mobile number, put that one in instead, so the practice can reach you.

The practice may also ask to see your passport and your visa (your BRP or eVisa share code) when you hand the form in, so have them ready.
